OtterLife: log a past workoutOtterLife：补记训练

Concept project, not affiliated with OtterLife.概念项目，与 OtterLife 无关联。

Role角色
Solo designer: research, sketching, wireframes, prototype独立设计：研究、草图、线框图、原型
Timeline周期
October 20262026 年 10 月
Tools工具
Figma, paper sketchesFigma、纸上草图

The problem问题

OtterLife assumes you plan before you train. Most people work out first and log afterwards, and that's where three things get in the way.OtterLife 默认你先计划再训练，但大多数人是先练完、再回来记录，这时会遇到三个障碍。

  • Finding the move. Every exercise is picked by its exact name from a long list.找动作：每个动作都要在长长的列表里按准确名称查找。
  • Timing it twice. Calories only count if the session was timed live, so logging afterwards means timing again.重复计时：只有实时计时才算卡路里，事后补记还得再计一次时。
  • Retyping weights. Weight and sets are entered by hand, every exercise, every session.重复输入重量：每个动作、每次训练都要手动输入重量和组数。

Research研究

  • My own daily use of the app, with a screenshot of each frustration我自己每天使用这款应用，并截图记录每一个痛点
  • 24 app store reviews from the US App Store, China App Store and 应用宝阅读美国、中国 App Store 及应用宝上的 24 条评论
  • A short survey, written and ready to send, on when people log their workouts一份已设计好、待发放的简短问卷，了解大家什么时候记录训练

Only 1 of the 24 reviews mentioned workout logging. The app mainly reads smartwatch data, so manual logging is a side path, and it hurts the people who rely on it most.24 条评论中只有 1 条提到训练记录。这款应用主要读取智能手表数据，手动记录只是支线功能，恰恰最影响依赖它的人。

Insight洞察

Logging a finished workout felt like redoing it.补记一次训练，感觉像是又练了一遍。

Design设计

A new "Log past workout" button sits beside "Start workout", with three ways in: same as last time, a quick session, or picking exercises.在“开始训练”旁边新增“补记训练”按钮，提供三种记录方式：和上次一样、快速记录、挑选动作。

Logging afterwards today现在的补记流程

  1. Open the Fitness tab打开健身页
  2. Search each exercise by name按名称逐个搜索动作
  3. Create a session for moves you can't find为找不到的动作新建记录
  4. Time the workout again再计一次时
  5. Type weight and sets for each exercise逐个输入重量和组数
  6. Only then see calories这才能看到卡路里

With the redesign重新设计后

  1. Tap "Log past workout"点“补记训练”
  2. Pick "Same as last time" or "Quick session"选“和上次一样”或“快速记录”
  3. Adjust anything different, then log调整不同的地方，然后记录
Watch demo观看演示

Next steps下一步

Next, I'll test the prototype with 5 people who log their workouts after training. I'll count the taps it takes to log a finished workout, before and after the redesign, and note whether each person finishes without help.下一步，我会请 5 位习惯练完再记录的用户测试原型，对比重新设计前后补记一次训练需要点几步，并记录每个人能否独立完成。

After that, I'd design picking moves by picture and include people who don't own a smartwatch.之后，我会设计按图片挑选动作的功能，并邀请没有智能手表的用户参与测试。

Beyond the Mic: group karaokeBeyond the Mic：多人 K 歌

At group karaoke, the people waiting for their turn drift off, especially during songs they don't know. I designed quiet, optional ways for them to join in without putting pressure on the singer.多人 K 歌时，等待的人很容易走神，尤其是遇到不熟悉的歌。我设计了一些安静、可选的参与方式，让他们加入进来，又不给正在唱歌的人压力。

Role角色
Research, persona, UI design, prototype and testing研究、用户画像、界面设计、原型与测试
Context背景
Course project, DECO2102课程项目 DECO2102
Tools工具
Figma, Canva; HTML, CSS, JavaScript for the working appFigma、Canva；可用版本使用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript

The question设计问题

How might we help people waiting for their turn stay socially engaged during group karaoke, without distracting or pressuring the current singer?如何让等待轮到自己的人在多人 K 歌中保持社交参与感，同时不打扰、不给正在唱歌的人压力？

What research showed研究发现

  • Unfamiliar songs and long waits make the audience disengage.不熟悉的歌和漫长的等待会让听众失去兴趣。
  • People already join in by singing along, cheering, clapping and chatting.大家本来就会跟唱、欢呼、鼓掌和聊天。
  • Joining in works best when it's optional, low-pressure and doesn't disrupt the singer.参与方式最好是可选的、低压力的，并且不打扰唱歌的人。

Studies back this up: group singing builds social bonds quickly, and familiar music increases enjoyment.相关研究也支持这一点：一起唱歌能快速建立社交联系，熟悉的音乐能带来更多乐趣。

"I want to feel part of the group, even when I'm not the one singing."“即使不是我在唱，我也想感觉自己是大家中的一员。”

Mia, the persona built from my research: 18 to 25, a university student who loves karaoke with friendsMia，根据研究建立的用户画像：18 至 25 岁，喜欢和朋友唱 K 的大学生

The design设计方案

Everyone joins the room from their phone. While waiting, they can vote on the room's lighting mood, play along to the rhythm, or send the singer silent cheers. The singer decides which of these are switched on, so the spotlight stays on them.每个人用手机加入房间。等待时，可以投票选择房间灯光氛围、跟着节奏互动，或给唱歌的人发送“无声应援”。哪些互动开启由唱歌的人决定，让焦点始终在他们身上。

Testing and what changed测试与改进

I ran scenario-based prototype reviews with 4 people aged 18 to 25: each imagined waiting while a friend sang. They were generally happy with the app, and their feedback led to these changes:我邀请 4 位 18 至 25 岁的参与者进行情境式原型评估：想象朋友正在唱歌、自己在等待。他们整体对应用比较满意，并根据反馈做了以下改进：

  • Clearer wording. "Make the wait part of the fun" became "While you're waiting", so the section's purpose is obvious.更清晰的文案：“让等待成为乐趣的一部分”改为“等待的时候”，让这一区域的用途一目了然。
  • A simpler screen. Fewer visual elements and stronger hierarchy on the interaction screen.更简洁的界面：减少互动页面的视觉元素，加强信息层级。
  • Connect your phone. Added Bluetooth pairing so people can play music from their own device.连接手机：新增蓝牙配对，可以用自己的手机播放音乐。
  • A more playful rhythm play. One participant asked for something cuter, so I explored a small singing character for this screen, kept clear of the controls.更有趣的节奏互动：有参与者希望界面更可爱，于是我为这个页面探索了一个唱歌的小角色，并确保不遮挡操作按钮。

Next, I'd measure task success and comfort ratings properly, as my original test plan intended, and test with a full group in a real karaoke room.下一步，我会按照最初的测试计划正式记录任务完成率和舒适度评分，并在真实的 K 歌包间里与整组用户测试。

From prototype to working app从原型到可用应用

To test it in a real room, I turned the final Figma design into a web app. A host creates a room, friends join with a 6-digit code on their own phones, and the queue, lyrics, mood votes, lighting suggestions and cheers update live for everyone. The singer approves every lighting change.为了在真实场景中测试，我把最终的 Figma 设计做成了网页应用。房主创建房间，朋友们用自己的手机输入 6 位房间码加入，歌单、歌词、氛围投票、灯光建议和应援都会实时同步。每一次灯光变化都需要唱歌的人同意。

寻径 Xunjing: find a trail that's in season寻径：找到当季能走的徒步路线

Trail information in China is scattered across RedNote posts, travel blogs and scenic-area notices. Each one gives different numbers, and few say when to go. I gathered it into one bilingual site where every route answers the same questions.国内的徒步信息分散在小红书、游记和景区公告里，数据各不相同，也很少说明什么时候去最好。我把这些信息整理成一个中英双语网站，让每条路线都回答同样的问题。

Role角色
Concept, content research, design and front-end build概念、内容研究、设计与前端搭建
Context背景
Self-initiated, October 2026个人项目，2026 年 10 月
Tools工具
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ECharts, Claude as a design and coding partnerHTML、CSS、JavaScript、ECharts，以 Claude 作为设计与编程助手

Who it's for目标用户

Young hikers in China who know they want to go somewhere but not where, or when. I've hiked in Sichuan myself, including Siguniang Second Peak at 5,276 m, and the hardest part of planning was finding out whether a route was in season or even open.想去徒步、但不确定去哪、什么时候去的国内年轻徒步者。我自己在四川徒步过，包括海拔 5,276 米的四姑娘山二峰，计划时最难的是弄清一条路线当季能不能走、有没有开放。

Design decisions设计决策

  • The same facts for every route. Distance, days, highest point and a 12-month season bar marked best, possible or avoid.每条路线都有同样的信息：距离、天数、最高点，以及标出“最佳 / 可去 / 避开”的 12 个月季节条。
  • Never invent a number. Where guides disagree the site shows the range. Where they say nothing it shows "No info", and every route links to its sources.绝不编造数据：攻略说法不一时显示范围，没有数据时显示“暂无信息”，每条路线都附上来源链接。
  • Safety stays visible. Expert-only routes carry a red warning. I removed the banned Ao–Tai Ridge entirely rather than list it, and flag routes that are currently restricted.安全提示始终可见：高难度路线有红色警示；被禁止穿越的鳌太线直接移除，受限路线会特别标注。
  • Credited photos only. Every photo shows its photographer and licence. Routes without a cleared photo use a drawn landscape instead.只用有授权的照片：每张照片都标注摄影师和授权；没有授权照片的路线用绘制的风景代替。

Two ways to explore两种浏览方式

The map is for planning: pick a month, trip length and altitude, and the routes that fit light up. The journey is for discovery: a full-screen photo of each route, grouped by province, where you step through a portal to the next trail.地图版用于规划：选择月份、天数和海拔，合适的路线就会亮起。旅程版用于探索：每条路线一张全屏照片，按省份分组，穿过“传送门”进入下一条路线。

Watch demo观看演示

What I learned收获

Most of the work was content, not code: checking 29 routes against several sources and deciding what to leave out. Next, I'd test it with hikers planning a real trip and add live closure notices.大部分工作在内容而不是代码：对照多个来源核对 29 条路线，并决定哪些不该放进来。下一步，我会请正在计划行程的徒步者来测试，并加入实时的封山公告。

A bit more更多信息

I chose interaction design because I love the moment an idea turns into something people can actually use. Outside class I'm always on the move: hiking, the gym and tennis, and I'll say yes to almost anything new. That same curiosity is how most of my projects start.我选择交互设计，是因为喜欢一个想法变成别人真正能用的东西的那一刻。课外的我是个闲不下来的人：徒步、健身、打网球，几乎任何新鲜事我都愿意试一试。我的大部分项目，也都是从这份好奇心开始的。
